rest(value: double) -> double => 1.0D - fraction(value)

mark(x: int, y: int, steep: bool, weight: double) is
    if steep then
        image.blend(y, x, weight)
    else
        image.blend(x, y, weight)
    fi

endpoint(
    x: double, y: double,
    gradient: double, gap: double,
    steep: bool
) -> (column: int, height: double) is
    let ends_at = Math.round(x)
    let height = y + gradient * (ends_at - x)

    let column = cast int(ends_at)
    let base = cast int(Math.floor(height))

    mark(column, base, steep, rest(height) * gap)
    mark(column, base + 1, steep, fraction(height) * gap)

    return (column = column, height = height)
si

line(from_x: double, from_y: double, to_x: double, to_y: double) is
    let steep =
        Math.abs(to_y - from_y) > Math.abs(to_x - from_x)

    let ax mut = if steep then from_y else from_x fi
    let ay mut = if steep then from_x else from_y fi
    let bx mut = if steep then to_y else to_x fi
    let by mut = if steep then to_x else to_y fi

    if ax > bx then
        let held_x = ax
        let held_y = ay

        ax = bx
        ay = by
        bx = held_x
        by = held_y
    fi

    let gradient =
        if bx == ax then 1.0D else (by - ay) / (bx - ax) fi

    let first =
        endpoint(ax, ay, gradient, rest(ax + 0.5D), steep)
    let last =
        endpoint(bx, by, gradient, fraction(bx + 0.5D), steep)

    let height mut = first.height + gradient

    for column in first.column + 1..last.column do
        let base = cast int(Math.floor(height))

        mark(column, base, steep, rest(height))
        mark(column, base + 1, steep, fraction(height))

        height = height + gradient
    od
si

    let angle =

        10.0D + 380.0D * Math.cos(angle),
